name: City timelapse
description: THE workhorse: the city grows from yearFrom to yearTo on its terrain — huts, village, stone town, grid, factories and rail, skyscrapers, glass skyline — with a huge ticking year counter, era lower-thirds synced to narration beats, district labels, population counter and a slow orbiting camera. Use for most scenes of a history-of-a-city video.

city.description: City name shown in the corner tag (≤ 24 chars). Also used to guess preset/style if those are omitted. The city is procedural — never a real map.

preset.description: Terrain: island between rivers, bay with hills, desert grid, river delta, lake shore, hilly peninsula, winding river plain. Keep the same preset for one city across the whole video.

style.description: Architecture: european old town, american grid, desert boomtown, asian mega-city. Keep constant per city.

seed.description: Same seed + preset + style = identical city in every scene. Use one seed per city for the whole video (e.g. 7).

keyDates.description: Optional real-world era years for this city (settlement, village, town, grid, industry, skyscraper, modern). Missing ones are spread evenly. Keep identical across scenes.

districts.description: Optional district names (≤ 8, ≤ 18 chars each) in order: core, waterfront, then outer quarters; index 4 is the industrial quarter.

light.description: auto = dawn mist → clear day → industrial haze → golden hour as the city grows. Fixed values for mood scenes.

camera.description: orbit (default, slow 14° turn + push-in), dolly (push-in only), flyover (wider turn, tilts down), reverse (pull-out), static.

kicker.description: Tiny label above the title (≤ 24 chars).

population.description: Population today (used to scale the counter). Default 8,000,000.

showPopulation.description: Show the small population counter under the year (default true).

yearTo.description: Year the scene ends (e.g. 2024). For a 10-minute video, each scene covers a slice: 1609→1700, 1700→1800 …

endsNow.description: Show 'NOW' instead of yearTo when the counter reaches it.

beats.description: 1–8 narration beats in order. The year ticks to each beat's year exactly when its keyword is spoken; the lower-third shows its label.

label.description: Lower-third title (≤ 32 chars), e.g. 'The grid is laid out'.

keyword.description: Word spoken in the narration when this beat lands.

titleUntil.description: Seconds after which the title fades (default 4.5).

beats.label: A trading post
beats.caption: A fort and thirty houses at the tip of the island

beats.label: The grid
beats.caption: A plan of straight avenues and numbered streets

beats.label: Bridges and steam
beats.caption: Factories, railways and the first great bridge

exampleNarration: It began as a fort at the tip of an island. Two centuries later the city drew a grid of straight streets across the land. Then came steam, factories and the first great bridge, and by the nineteen-thirties the race to the sky had begun.
